fichas.title: Modern Zoo Planning and Infrastructure
fichas.summary: A modern zoo balances animal welfare, species-conservation research, visitor experience, and operational needs. Planning includes animal-geography zones, visitor and service infrastructure, animal medical-care facilities, and separated public and operational circulation. The Leipzig Zoo master plan illustrates an adventure-world approach. The text cites Directive 1999/22/EC and lists requirements concerning research, education, species-appropriate care, escape and pest prevention, and collection records.
spaces: Animal-geography zones: Asia, Africa, Pongoland, Founder's garden, South America, and Gondwana land
Staff cafeteria, training rooms, and rest rooms
uses: Animal keeping, feeding, veterinary care, and species-appropriate enclosure design
Species-conservation research and participation in international breeding programmes
Feed, waste, animal, and emergency transport
